module: Class of a vehicle managed by the traffic system (gameplay_traffic). It tracks the vehicle's state (reset, active, fadeIn, fadeOut, queued, locked), its driver role (standard, police, suspect, empty), its road tracking (roadTracking), its collisions, its offenses and its police pursuit state (pursuit). It also handles out-of-sight respawn, headlights, horn and siren, and the AI mode.
usage:
local veh = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/traffic/vehicle')({id = vehId})
if veh then veh:postInit(); veh:setAiMode('traffic') end
notes: The module returns a constructor: the parameter (table) becomes the object and init(o.id) is called; returns nil if the vehicle is invalid (not found or ignoreTraffic flag). The second parameter 'role' of init is not used.
Cadence: onTrafficTick is called every 0.25 s of simulated time (TICK_TIME); SLOW_SPEED is 2.5 m/s.
pursuit.mode: 0 = no pursuit, 1 = passive, 2 = aggressive, 3 = aggressive with roadblocks, -1 = stopped (arrest).

Offenses tested by checkOffenses: speeding (>= max(16.7 m/s, 1.2 x limit)), racing (>= max(27.8 m/s, 2 x limit)), reckless, wrongWay, intersection, hitPolice, hitTraffic. They only count if the police's strictness > 0.
Values of self.respawn: spawnValue (0 disables respawn), spawnDirBias (-1 to 1), spawnRandomization (0 to 1), activeRadius, finalRadius, innerRadius, staticVisibility.
The getters self.getTraffic, getPolice, getTrafficVars and getPoliceVars are references to gameplay_traffic / gameplay_police, modifiable from outside.
Emitted hooks: onTrafficAction (changeRole), onPursuitOffense, onTrafficVehicleCrashed, onPursuitAction (arrest, release, roadblock, roadblockAlert, evade) for vehicles outside the main traffic.
In onVehicleResetted, role.flags.freeze is set to false (and not nil) whereas the other roles test the flag's truthiness.

C.desc: Traffic vehicle object. Common fields: id, state, isAi, isPerson, isVehicle, isPlayerControlled, model, modelName, drivability, autoRole, role, tracking (roadTracking), collisions, pursuit, respawn, pos/dirVec/vel/driveVec/targetPos, speed, damage, alpha, focus, focusDist, enableRespawn, enableTracking, enableAutoPooling, camVisible, headlights, queuedFuncs.

init.desc: Initializes the traffic vehicle: forces visibility, creates collision and deferred function tables, the roadTracking object and the getters, calls resetAll, measures width/length and sets the default 'empty' role. Does nothing (and the constructor returns nil) if the vehicle does not exist or has ignoreTraffic.

role.desc: Not used in the function body.

postInit.desc: To call after initialization: applies the model/config data (applyModelConfigData) then the chosen automatic role (autoRole).

applyModelConfigData.desc: Deduced from the model and config data: display name, drivability (from the off-road score and size), random paint, taxi, vehicle status (types car, truck, automation, traffic, proptraffic, player) and automatic role ('police' for police configs, otherwise 'standard'; 'empty' if not a vehicle).

resetPursuit.desc: Resets the pursuit state (mode 0, scores, counters, timers); if a pursuit was ongoing, first calls gameplay_police.setPursuitMode(0, id).

resetTracking.desc: Refreshes roadTracking and resets collision counters and crash damage; stores the current damage as a reference.

resetValues.desc: Resets the respawn values (from the traffic variables), and clears collisions, deferred functions and active data.

resetElectrics.desc: Turns off the vehicle's light bar, warnings and horn (vehicle Lua commands).

honkHorn.desc: Turns on the horn then stops it after the given duration (deferred function 'horn').

useSiren.desc: Turns on the light bar with siren (signal 2) then sets it back to 1 (or 0 if disableAfterUse) after the given duration. Assumes the vehicle has a light bar. Uses the same deferred entry 'horn' as honkHorn: the two overwrite each other.

disableAfterUse.desc: If true, turns the light bar off at the end instead of lights-only mode.

setAiMode.desc: Sets the vehicle's AI mode (ai.setMode) and its automatic parameters: 'traffic' (base aggression, legal speed, lane driving), 'random', 'flee' and 'chase' (aggression >= 0.8 for flee/chase, no speed limit). Sets isAi to false if the mode is 'disabled'. Ends with ai.reset().

mode.desc: AI mode; uses trafficVars.aiMode if nil. Examples: 'traffic', 'random', 'flee', 'chase', 'follow', 'stop', 'disabled'.

ignoreParams.desc: If true, does not set the automatic parameters nor reset the AI.

setAiParameters.desc: Applies to the AI the aggression, the speed limit (negative = legal speed) and the aiAware setting (car avoidance) from params or, by default, from the traffic variables.

setRole.desc: Changes the driver's role: ends the old role (onRoleEnded), creates the new one via trafficUtils.getRoleConstructor, calls onRoleStarted and emits the hook onTrafficAction(id, 'changeRole', ...).

getInteractiveDistance.desc: Returns the distance between the vehicle's "look ahead" point (targetPos, 10 to 50 m ahead depending on speed) and a position.

squared.desc: If true, returns the squared distance.

returns.desc: Distance in meters (math.huge if pos is nil).

modifyRespawnValues.desc: Immediately increases the respawn radii to keep the vehicle active longer (used after a collision and during pursuits).

getBrakingDistance.desc: Estimates the braking distance: v² / (2 · accel · g), with g bounded to avoid a division by zero.

accel.desc: Deceleration as a fraction of g (the driver's aggression by default).

checkCollisions.desc: Detects contacts with the other objects on the map (OBB check), creates and updates the collision tables (counter, speed, damage, dot product), notifies the role (onCollision) and the other traffic vehicles (onOtherCollision) when the speed >= 1 m/s, and handles the case of a pedestrian (unicycle) being hit (the AI stops then resumes).

trackCollision.desc: Evolves a collision's state: 'active' then 'resolved' (stopped near the site for 5 s) or 'abandoned' (the vehicle moves away); clears the collision when the other vehicle is more than 120 m away.

fade.desc: Varies the vehicle's opacity; at 0 when fading out the state becomes 'queued', at 1 when fading in it becomes 'active'.

isFadeOut.desc: true to disappear, false/nil to appear.

checkRayCast.desc: Tests the static line of sight between two points (castRayStatic).

returns.desc: true if the ray reaches the position without obstacle.

updateActiveRadius.desc: Updates the radii that decide whether the vehicle can respawn: active radius decreasing according to spawnValue and visibility, plus an extra radius depending on the focus's speed and direction.

tryRespawn.desc: Tests whether the vehicle is far enough from the focus to respawn (never the player's vehicle) and that no non-traffic vehicle is too close; then switches to the 'fadeOut' state and turns off horn and headlights.

triggerOffense.desc: Records a pursuit offense (unique key, default score 100, divided by 2 for an AI), updates counters and additional score and emits the hook onPursuitOffense the first time.

data.desc: {key = string, score? = number, value?, threshold?}; without key, nothing is done.

checkOffenses.desc: Evaluates the vehicle's offenses for the police (speeding, racing, reckless driving, wrong way, light/stop, collision with police or traffic) from the roadTracking faults and the collisions. No effect if strictness <= 0.

checkPoliceVisibility.desc: Determines the closest police, increases or decreases sightValue (visibility 0 to 1; policeVisible if >= 0.5) and updates the pursuit score.

checkTimeOfDay.desc: Indicates whether it is daytime based on the game time and the solar night window.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Called when the vehicle is reset (automatic or manual): unfreezes the vehicle if needed and resets tracking.

onActiveDone.desc: Called after fading out or being sent to the inactive pool; relays to role:onActiveDone().

onRespawn.desc: Called after a respawn in traffic: repaints at random if allowed, increments respawnCount, sets the state to 'reset'.

onRefresh.desc: Called when the vehicle data must be refreshed (usually after a respawn). For an AI: reset, playerUsable setting, AI debug mode, night adjustment of spawnValue (x0.25), active/fadeIn state, reset of the role's action and personality, AI parameters. Then calls role:onRefresh().

onTrafficTick.desc: Traffic tick (0.25 s): updates road tracking, visibility, active radius, headlights (night or tunnel), detects crash damage (hook onTrafficVehicleCrashed) and near misses, then calls role:onTrafficTick.

onPursuitUpdate.desc: Advances the pursuit: alert, arrest (arrestTime), release, roadblocks (mode 3), evasion (evadeTime), arrest and evasion radii, and the normalized values arrestValue and evadeValue. For a vehicle outside the main traffic, emits the onPursuitAction hooks directly.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame update: reads position, direction and speed from map.objects, computes driveVec and targetPos, handles the states (locked, fadeIn, fadeOut), paces the traffic ticks, tracks collisions and police, runs the deferred functions and calls role:onUpdate.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes the traffic vehicle's state (including road tracking and role) for saving.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the state from the onSerialize table, recreates the role and restores tracking; sets the state to 'queued' if the object is not active.
